resource_load.note: 1 DB query (find+count) + N decryption operations for auth headers

performance_issues.description: Loop decrypts authorization header for each webhook using secret.DecryptSecret
performance_issues.impact: For large numbers of system webhooks, decryption adds latency per item
performance_issues.recommendation: Acceptable for admin endpoint with typically few system webhooks

performance_issues.description: EditSystemHook re-fetches the webhook after update instead of returning the mutated object
performance_issues.impact: Extra DB read on every edit, but acceptable for admin endpoint
performance_issues.recommendation: Could return the already-updated webhook object instead of re-fetching

resource_load.note: DELETE webhook + DELETE hook_tasks in transaction
1 SELECT (check exists) + 6 INSERTs in transaction (org, org_user, team, team_units, team_user, avatar)
COUNT query + SELECT query with pagination

performance_issues.description: Organization list is fetched from DB on every request with no caching
performance_issues.impact: For instances with many organizations, repeated admin queries hit DB directly
performance_issues.recommendation: Acceptable for admin-only endpoint; caching not needed unless high admin API traffic

resource_load.note: 1 external API call (HaveIBeenPwned) + 2 SELECT checks + 2 INSERTs + optional auth source lookup

performance_issues.description: HaveIBeenPwned API call uses http.DefaultClient with no timeout configured
performance_issues.impact: If pwnedpasswords.com is slow or unresponsive, the request thread blocks indefinitely
performance_issues.recommendation: Configure a timeout (e.g., 5s) on the HTTP client used for pwned password checks

optimization_recommendations.description: Add HTTP client timeout for HaveIBeenPwned API calls
optimization_recommendations.estimated_impact: Prevents request thread from blocking indefinitely on external API failure
optimization_recommendations.implementation: Create http.Client with Timeout: 5*time.Second instead of using http.DefaultClient
